entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: M 栏空缺、R 栏残损（T99 污损），汉栏硼/窰歧读、词头 quefa qª 未定，材料不足不敢定夺；仅词头 horno 可辨，属炉窑类。

entries.zh: 金属烤炉（烘炉饼之炉）；炉饼
entries.en: metal baking oven (for hornillos, small ovens); oven-baked cake (lô-piánn)
entries.notes: R 栏空缺；词头 hornillos/horrillos 与汉栏首字拖/抱皆歧读，依 M 栏 hvā lou pià 取炉饼义。

entries.zh: 灰窑；石灰窑（烧石灰供各家所用的窑）
entries.en: lime kiln (for supplying all the houses with lime)
entries.notes: 汉栏硼/窰歧读，M 栏 yō 音证为窑。

entries.zh: 灰炉；烧石灰的炉（供各家所用）
entries.en: lime furnace/kiln (for all the houses)

entries.zh: 菜；蔬菜
entries.en: vegetable; garden produce (hortaliza)

entries.zh: 芫荽（香菜）；调味菜蔬
entries.en: coriander (culantro); potherb / seasoning herb
entries.notes: 汉栏仅存芫一字，M 栏三音节与 R 栏 culantro 互证为芫荽全词。

entries.zh: 菜蔬；蔬菜
entries.en: vegetables; greens

entries.zh: 草菜；青菜（可食菜蔬之属）
entries.en: greens; edible herb vegetables

entries.zh: 茗菜；上等珍视的菜蔬
entries.en: choice / prized vegetable; one particularly esteemed
entries.notes: 词头 particularⁿ/tinadaⁿ 缩写展开依赖推断，R 栏 estimada 证被珍视义。

entries.zh: 园丁；种菜园的人（做园人）
entries.en: gardener; keeper / tiller of a kitchen garden
entries.notes: 汉栏空缺、词头 Hortelano/Horelano 歧读；依 M 栏 chō hūỹ lang（做园人）与西语 hortelano 取义。

entries.zh: 留；留人住下（挽留住宿）
entries.en: to lodge; to keep / retain (someone to stay)

entries.zh: 宿；住宿歇夜（如在客栈）
entries.en: to lodge; to stay overnight (as at a meson / inn)

entries.zh: 迎接；欢迎款待（迎客相待）
entries.en: to welcome and entertain; to receive (a guest) kindly
entries.notes: M 栏尾部与 R 栏皆残损（含 T99，R arecebuⁿ? 未定），暂依词头 hospedar y regalar 与汉栏迎字取义。

entries.zh: 留宿；留人过夜
entries.en: to put up for the night; to lodge overnight

entries.zh: 留人客；留客住宿（接待宾客）
entries.en: to lodge a guest; to receive and put up a visitor

entries.zh: 客情；待客的情礼（殷勤款待来客）
entries.en: hospitality; kindly entertainment of a guest
entries.notes: 词头 algn m.to 等缩写展开未全定，义依 H 客情 / M qüég chēng。

entries.zh: 万般应承；有求皆应（对客人所请一概应承）
entries.en: to consent / comply in every respect; to grant every (guest's) request
entries.notes: 汉栏航/舦歧读，M 栏 poā̃ 音近般，疑为萬般應承；词头缩写多重，义从 H/M 栏。

entries.zh: 歇宿；投宿（客栈歇夜）
entries.en: to lodge at an inn; to stop over for the night

entries.zh: 厅；客舍厅堂（待客之所）
entries.en: guest hall; lodging place (hospedería)

entries.zh: 所堂；馆舍厅堂（接待客人之所）
entries.en: guest hall; reception hall / lodging house
entries.notes: R 栏仅存 siaⁿ² 后即残；词头 hospedexia 形式存疑（疑为 hospedería 变体），义依 H 所堂与 M 栏音。
